constraint_risk.detail: Inclusive bound rendered as 'shaam 6 baje ya uske baad' (= at or after 6 PM). The words shaam/शाम/संध्याकाळी ('evening') were added next to '6' only to make 6 PM unambiguous vs 6 AM; they are not a new constraint, but a reviewer should confirm they do not read as a window ('in the evening'). Availability (seats > 0) is stated explicitly in all four variants ('have seats available' and its equivalent), matching the gold constraint; a reviewer should confirm it reads as a requirement on the recommended train.

notes.detail: Highest-risk item: time inclusivity, budget bound, seats-available requirement and no-booking all live in one query.
